# Solvix Solutions

> Solvix Solutions builds premium business websites, AI chatbots, and automation systems for growing businesses, based in Karachi, Pakistan and serving clients worldwide.

Solvix Solutions exists to solve two problems for small and mid-sized businesses: getting more customers, and giving business owners back their time. Founded by Umair.

## Services

- **Business Websites** — Custom, fast-loading, mobile-responsive websites built to convert visitors into inquiries, with SEO foundations from day one.
- **AI Chatbots** — Chatbots trained on a specific business that answer customer questions instantly, qualify leads, and can book appointments, 24/7.
- **AI Automation** — Connects existing tools (calendars, forms, CRMs, email) so information flows automatically without manual admin work.
- **Landing Pages** — Single-purpose, conversion-focused pages for ad campaigns and launches.
- **Appointment Booking Systems** — Self-serve booking synced to calendars with automatic reminders, reducing no-shows.
- **CSR Support & Dispatch** — AI call answering and job routing built specifically for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other field service businesses.

## Pricing

Solvix offers tiered monthly plans (Starter, Growth, Pro, and Dispatch Pro), starting around $149/month plus a one-time setup fee. See /pricing for current details.

## Differentiators

- Non-technical clients are fully supported — Solvix handles all technical work and explains everything in plain language.
- Can integrate with or rebuild an existing website rather than requiring a from-scratch rebuild.
- Field-service dispatch offering (CSR Support & Dispatch) is a specialized, less commonly offered service among AI website/automation agencies.
